info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Coverages-v1-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Coverage Query API provides users with access to detailed coverage options for auto insurance quotes. This API is designed for insurance providers and brokers looking to retrieve comprehensive information about available coverages based on specific quotes. Users can utilize this service to enhance their offerings and assist customers in making informed decisions about their auto insurance coverage. Typical use cases include comparing coverage options and integrating with client management systems to present diverse insurance solutions.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch available coverage options for quotes, providing necessary details to assist users in making informed decisions regarding their insurance policies.
